nodes.title: Verify Transaction
nodes.summary: This section describes how to verify the status of a transaction using its unique reference and provides environment details for the API.

nodes.title: Response Data Object
nodes.summary: This section details the structure of the data object returned in the API response, including possible transaction statuses.

nodes.title: Verify Transaction Endpoint
nodes.summary: This GET endpoint allows verification of a transaction using its unique transaction reference.

nodes.title: Verify a Transaction Description
nodes.summary: This section explains how to use the endpoint to verify the validity of a transaction by replacing the placeholder with the actual transaction reference.

nodes.title: Parameters
nodes.summary: This section lists the query parameters required for the Verify Transaction endpoint, specifically the transaction_ref.

nodes.title: 200: OK Response
nodes.summary: Describes a successful transaction verification response, including detailed transaction information and its corresponding JSON structure.

nodes.title: 400: Bad Request Response
nodes.summary: Describes the response for an invalid transaction reference, indicating a bad request and its corresponding JSON structure.

nodes.title: 401: Unauthorized Response
nodes.summary: Describes the response for an unauthorized request, indicating missing or invalid authorization credentials and its corresponding JSON structure.

nodes.title: 403: Forbidden Response
nodes.summary: Describes the response for a forbidden request, typically due to an invalid API key, and its corresponding JSON structure.
